greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * Hmm...\n* You're new to the\n  underground-\d[3]\sk

greeting.speaker: SUSIE
greeting.dialogue: * Great. A talking\n  dandelion. Move, weed,\n  we're walking here.

greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * Hey! No need to be rude.\n* I was just greeting the\n  human to the underground.

greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * As I was saying, you\n  must be so confused.

greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * Somebody's ought to teach\n  you how things work\n  around here!

greeting.speaker: SUSIE
greeting.dialogue: * ... Now, will you move\n  aside or will I have to\n  do it by force?

greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * But don't you want to\n  learn about your \c[yellow]SOUL\c[white]?\n* About your \c[yellow]LOVE\c[white]?

greeting.speaker: SUSIE
greeting.dialogue: * Why the hell would we\n  care?

greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * The underground is full\n  of dangerous monsters.

greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * The human needs to learn\n  how to defend themselves.

greeting.speaker: SUSIE
greeting.dialogue: * A dumb little flower\n  teaching self-defense?\n* I'm good, thanks.

heated_up.speaker: FLOWEY
heated_up.dialogue: * \sp[2]\s[1]You think you can talk to\n  me like that, you IDIOT?!

heated_up.speaker: SUSIE
heated_up.dialogue: * Wow. Gross face. Change\n  it back before I step on\n  you.

heated_up.speaker: FLOWEY
heated_up.dialogue: * \s[1]What? WHO do you think\n  you ARE?

heated_up.speaker: SUSIE
heated_up.dialogue: * You're nowhere near as\n  intimidating as you think.

heated_up.speaker: FLOWEY
heated_up.dialogue: * Look, I might look like a\n  flower, but-\d[3]\sk

pre_battle.speaker: SUSIE
pre_battle.dialogue: * FINE!! If it will get you\n  to SHUT UP, hurry up and\n  show us.

post_battle.speaker: SUSIE
post_battle.dialogue: * I knew something was up\n  with that flower.

post_battle.speaker: SUSIE
post_battle.dialogue: * What the hell have we\n  gotten ourselves into?
